proof_body:
by
  intro f a L
  constructor
  · intro h x hx hxa
    exact h.comp (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hxa, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hx⟩)
  · intro h
    rw [Filter.tendsto_iff_seq_tendsto]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hx
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hx2
    have h2 := h (fun n => x (n + N)) (fun n => hN _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _)) ((Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat N).mpr hx1)
    exact (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat (f := f ∘ x) N).mp h2
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a L : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ) (nhds L) ↔ ∀ x : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, x n ≠ a) → Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds a) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => f (x n)) Filter.atTop (nhds L)
